title: Ignore attached artwork when classifying audio uploads
problem: MP3 files with embedded artwork are classified as video because FFprobe reports cover art as an attached video stream. The audio preview command then auto-selects that image and fails while creating its MP4 output.
reproduce: At pinned revision 2b4e84b, a generated MP3 with a PNG attached as cover art makes has_video_stream return true. Sending the same file through the audio preview command fails because FFmpeg maps both the attached image and audio.
acceptance: An MP3 with attached artwork remains an audio input, produces both the transcription WAV and audio-only MP4 preview, and a genuine video file continues to be classified as video.
repair: Use FFprobe's real-video stream selector, which excludes attached pictures, and explicitly map the first audio stream while disabling video in both audio conversion commands.

verification.limitations: BCL generates the affected MP3 structure with FFmpeg, proves the baseline misclassification, and verifies WAV and MP4 output after the repair. It does not submit a complete transcription job to the deployed SUNET service.
verification.ownerCheck: Upload the original Pro Tools MP3 with album art and confirm the job reaches transcription, publishes its audio preview, and matches the result from the otherwise identical file without artwork.

publish.commitMessage: Fix audio processing for MP3 files with album art
